name: MsoSignatureSubset
description: Specifies properties of the signature subset. These settings act as filters for signature sets.

constants.name: msoSignatureSubsetSignaturesAllSigs
constants.description: All non-visible signatures plus all signed signature lines.

constants.name: msoSignatureSubsetSignatureLinesSigned
constants.description: Signature lines that have been signed.

constants.name: msoSignatureSubsetSignatureLinesUnsigned
constants.description: Signature lines that have not been signed.

constants.name: msoSignatureSubsetAll
constants.description: All non-visible signatures plus all signature lines.
